name: md-card-decoder
description: 卡片解码者：Rust/WASM 求解器 + 静态网页（把 public/ 上传到 Cloudflare Workers）

scripts.data:build: cargo run --release -q -p decoder-cli -- data build data/raw build/data && cp build/data/summary.json data/summary.json
scripts.data:check: cargo run --release -q -p decoder-cli -- data compare-legacy dist/cards-data.js build/data/cards.bin && cargo run --release -q -p decoder-cli -- check-rules dist/cards-data.js build/data/cards.bin
